title: A Tiny Change Takes the Hook
synopsis: A small contributor guide clarification exercises the PR hook, which catches a normal creation attempt and sends it through Tracetoon's preview workflow.
altText: Sam asks Pixel the cat for a tiny documentation change to test the PR hook. Pixel explains that the Showtail and tracetoon checkouts must be neighbors. Glitch tries to rush the PR, but the hook requires a preview. Pixel reports 68 passing tests and a ready preview.

panels.scene: Sam asks Pixel for a small documentation change to exercise the newly installed PR hook.

dialogue.speaker: sam
dialogue.text: One tiny doc change. Let's try the PR hook.

panels.scene: Pixel checks the TypeScript paths and adds a sentence about the two sibling checkouts.

dialogue.speaker: pixel
dialogue.text: Showtail and tracetoon need to be neighbors. Now the guide explains why.

panels.scene: Glitch watches a normal PR creation attempt get caught by the newly installed hook.
Pixel presents the prepared PR preview to Sam after the documentation checks pass.
